Package net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.addon

Interface CozyVoicePlugin

public interface CozyVoicePlugin
Entry point of a Cozy Voice Chat addon. Implement it in a class annotated with CozyVoiceAddon.

One instance is created per annotated class, on both physical sides (client and dedicated server). Keep client-only code (rendering, Minecraft classes) out of this class or behind a FMLEnvironment.dist check, otherwise a dedicated server will fail to load it.

Since:
1.1.0

  • Method Details

    • getId

      String getId()
      Unique id of the addon, shown in logs and in /cozyvoice addons. Usually your mod id. Use lowercase letters, digits, _, - and .. If two addons report the same id, only the first one is registered.
      Returns:
      the addon id, not blank

    • onRegister

      default void onRegister(CozyVoiceApi api)
      Called once when the addon is registered, during FMLCommonSetupEvent on the main thread. Register event listeners, route hooks and similar here. No server is running yet, so server-only actions (groups, channels, mutes) must wait for a server event such as ServerStartedEvent.

      An exception thrown here is logged and the addon is not registered; it does not crash the game.

      Parameters:
      api - the Cozy Voice Chat API, same as CozyVoiceApi.get()
